        private static void PopulateFromJsonBody(System.ReadOnlySpan<byte> bodyBytes, global::TestNamespace.UpdateItemCommand operation)
        {

                else if (reader.ValueTextEquals("description"u8))

                    reader.Read();
                    operation.Description = reader.GetString();

                else
                {
                    reader.Skip();
                }
            }
